name: loadtest-k6
description: Pruebas de carga con k6 - Ejercicio QA

scripts.test: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force results | Out-Null; & 'C:\Program Files\k6\k6.exe' run script.js"
scripts.test:summary: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force results | Out-Null; & 'C:\Program Files\k6\k6.exe' run script.js | Tee-Object -FilePath results\textSummary.txt"
scripts.test:json: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force results | Out-Null; & 'C:\Program Files\k6\k6.exe' run script.js --out json=results\resultados.json"
scripts.test:html: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force results | Out-Null; & 'C:\Program Files\k6\k6.exe' run script.js --out web-dashboard=export=results\report.html"
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:summary && npm run test:json && npm run test:html
